name: h3lite
description: Local MiniMax H3 production suite: environment setup, prompt craft, storyboarding, generation, post-production, and Blender white-model previz with direct Ref2VA motion-reference handoff. Adds a pre-flight show contract (show.json/canon.json), batch showrunner with resume, native --ref-video wiring, Set C asset verification, explicit cache/QA reuse, and 16 GB measured-canvas Set C auto-routing that blocks unsafe or under-specified renders before GPU time.
